figure.purpose: Money, prices, counts, percentages, and compact metadata.

components.name: Action Button
components.description: Strong Save or Done action with compact product density.
components.css: .ds-action-button { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--action, #242a35); color: var(--action-foreground, #f1f4f8); font: 600 14px/1 var(--font-sans, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-action-button:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #151e2a); } .ds-action-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #58a6ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filled Input
components.description: Quiet filled field that avoids heavy border framing.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--body, #c3ccd8); font: 500 13px/1.4 var(--font-sans, sans-serif); } .ds-field input { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface, #111821); color: var(--foreground, #e6edf3); font: 400 14px/1.4 var(--font-sans, sans-serif); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #58a6ff); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Period Tabs
components.description: Underline peer navigation for Today, Week, and Month views.
components.css: .ds-period-tabs { display: flex; gap: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(255,255,255,.07)); } .ds-period-tabs button { padding: 0 0 10px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #7a8492); font: 500 13px/1.4 var(--font-sans, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-period-tabs button:hover { color: var(--foreground, #e6edf3); } .ds-period-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #58a6ff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-period-tabs .ds-active { border-bottom-color: var(--foreground, #e6edf3); color: var(--foreground, #e6edf3); }

components.name: Trade Tag
components.description: Compact verdict chip with redundant icon and color channels.
components.css: .ds-trade-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--tag-positive-bg, rgba(29,178,107,.14)); color: var(--tag-positive-fg, #1db26b); font: 500 11px/1.3 var(--font-mono, monospace); }

components.name: Coach Voice
components.description: AI-authored interpretation distinguished from trader annotations.
components.html:
Coach read

Your best trades came after patient confirmation.
components.css: .ds-coach-voice { padding-left: 16px; border-left: 2px solid var(--coach, #3fb950); color: var(--body, #c3ccd8); font: 400 16px/1.6 var(--font-sans, sans-serif); } .ds-coach-label { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--coach, #3fb950); font: 600 12px/1.3 var(--font-sans, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .02em; } .ds-coach-voice p:last-child { margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: Trading Journal AI combines the clarity of a trading ledger with the breathing room of an editorial notebook. Type, spacing, tabular figures, and thin rules establish hierarchy while controls remain compact and content areas avoid unnecessary framing.
keyCharacteristics: Type-first hierarchy with open surfaces and hairline structure.
Ledger-like metrics beside generous journal prose.
Four semantic-token themes: dark, light, daylight, and evening.
Distinct visual authorship for trader annotations and AI coaching.
Restrained motion and decoration in service of review speed.

rules.name: The Semantic Token Rule
rules.body: Components consume semantic CSS variables; raw color values belong in the theme definitions, not component markup.

rules.name: The Trading Color Rule
rules.body: Red and green indicate P&L, outcome, execution, or clearly labeled process signals and never stand alone.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Coach-authored content uses coach green; trader annotations use the theme accent.

rules.name: The Mono-With-Purpose Rule
rules.body: Use mono for data and compact metadata, not ordinary prose or every heading.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface earns elevation only when its interaction model requires separation from document flow.

dos: Do read the canonical design-system document before changing UI.
Do use semantic tokens from globals.css and verify every theme affected.
Do let typography, spacing, and one hairline establish hierarchy.
Do keep numeric columns tabular and P&L signs explicit.
donts: Don't nest cards or wrap every section in a rounded box.
Don't introduce raw hex colors in components.
Don't use red or green as generic decoration.
Don't add decorative motion that slows scanning or writing.
